items.prompt: Przepraszam, nie mam ___. (Sorry, I don't have time.)
items.explanation: After nie the object takes the genitive. Czas takes -u: czasu.
optionNotes: The accusative: after nie the object changes.
The instrumental, used after z meaning "with".

items.explanation: Lubię kawę, but after nie: Nie lubię kawy.
optionNotes: The accusative: correct without nie, but not after nie.
The nominative is not used for an object.
The instrumental, used after z meaning "with".

items.explanation: The owner comes after the thing, in the genitive: pokój siostry.
optionNotes: Siostrę is the accusative; the owner takes the genitive.
The owner must be in the genitive.

items.prompt: Herbata bez ___, proszę. (Tea without sugar, please.)
items.explanation: Bez takes the genitive. Cukier loses its e: cukru.
optionNotes: The nominative: bez needs the genitive.
The instrumental, and the e drops out.
Cukier takes -u, and the e drops out: cukru.
